reviews.title: Островок спокойствия
reviews.text:
Я не очень верила в медитации, но когда поняла, что моя нервная система не вывозит, решила попробовать. 

Впервые я скачала Мо во время пандемии: во время изоляции и неопределённости снижение темпа и наличие схемы действий очень успокаивает. И это сложно переоценить. 
Потом я вернулась к Мо в 2022 и в 2024 годах. Регулярно делать практики получается редко, но в периоды ярких тревог и переживаний Мо помогает успокоиться и найти баланс.

Спасибо авторам за создание такого инструмента первой самопомощи

reviews.title: Worst experience
reviews.text:
My 5-year-old child accidentally made purchases in several apps while using my phone. Every other company I contacted handled the situation reasonably and issued a refund. This is the only app that refused.

The issue is not the amount charged — it’s the approach. An application centered around mindfulness and well-being showed no flexibility or understanding in a clearly unintentional purchase made by a child. That contrast speaks for itself.

Based on this experience, I cannot recommend interacting with this app.

reviews.title: Mental reset
reviews.text: A colleague recommended Mo, and the "Antistress" and "Concentration" packs have been lifesavers. Using the app for just 10 minutes during my lunch break helps me reset and tackle the afternoon with a clear head.

reviews.title: Progress tracking
reviews.text: The integration with Apple Health is brilliant. I love seeing my meditation streaks and minutes contribute to my overall health data. I don't know, maybe it is because it makes my commitment feel tangible.

reviews.title: Would be 5 if…
reviews.text:
I will say I never thought I cared for apps like this until I started dealing with anxiety which has gotten far better since downloading and using Mo. I do love being able to download my favorite sounds but my only complaint (the reason for the 4 stars) would be the Apple Watch version of this being very limited. I recently started sleeping with my Apple Watch on to keep track of my sleeping and would love to see an update implementing your favorite sounds/tracks being accessible from the Apple Watch. 

Please, please, please make this possible! Hate having to grab my phone, start a soundscape, then having to control it from the “media player” and not from the Mo Apple Watch app itself.

reviews.title: Huge library
reviews.text: I've explored topics from self-esteem to relationships, and each course feels tailored and insightful. It’s a huge library of calm, and well worth the subscription. With the weekly updates, I never get bored.

reviews.title: Finally works
reviews.text: I’ve struggled with insomnia for years and tried everything: sleep pills, white noise, even herbal teas. Mo is the only thing that actually works. On top of that, I wake up feeling refreshed!

reviews.title: Strong recommendation
reviews.text: Mo has helped me build a consistent routine that I actually look forward to every single day. That's why I'm so fond of this app and I always recommend it to anyone dealing with lots of stress or anxiety.

reviews.title: Cool app

reviews.title: Academic support
reviews.text: Final exams had me panicking until I found Mo's anti-stress meditations. The 4-minute emergency calm session saved me during my oral presentation. So it has been a game changer for my academic stress.

reviews.title: Stress reduction
reviews.text: We implemented Mo as part of our workplace wellness program and the feedback has been phenomenal. Seeing measurable reductions in stress levels across every department speaks volumes about its effectiveness.

reviews.title: Adult relaxation
reviews.text: Three kids under five meant I forgot what restful sleep was... until Mo's bedtime stories for adults. I haven't made it to the end of one yet without falling asleep. Certainly something I'd recommend.

reviews.title: Insomnia help
reviews.text: As someone who's struggled with insomnia for years, Mo's sleep meditations finally help me turn off my racing mind. Each meditation knocks me out faster than any sleeping pill ever did.

reviews.title: Confidence boost
reviews.text: I tried meditating before but always felt like I was 'doing it wrong.' Mo's beginner course explained everything perfectly, no jargon, just clear guidance. And now I feel more confident and calmer.

reviews.title: Mental health
reviews.text: Evidence-based with actual mental health professional endorsements? Check. Measurable progress tracking via Apple Health? Check. I love that this app delivers clinically-proven benefits in a structured, measurable way.

reviews.title: Adult stories
reviews.text: I laughed when I saw adult bedtime stories, but now I swear by them. They’re beautifully narrated and deeply relaxing. I fall asleep faster than ever before. Thank you so much!

reviews.title: Expert courses
reviews.text: I’ve tried therapy and expensive wellness programs, but Mo gives me similar benefits at a fraction of the cost. For what you get (guided sessions and expert-designed courses), this app is a steal.
